name: Sandpines Golf Links
architects: Rees Jones (opened 1993; formerly Florence Golf Links) (Wikipedia, top100golfcourses.com; unverified)

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP 1 m bare-earth DEM (3DEPElevation ImageServer exportImage, float32, EPSG:32610, box x 410050-411850 / y 4871950-4873450), downloaded by the developer 2026-10-24 (GitHub release florence-data, exportImage.16.tiff). The DOGAMI DTM/CHM downloads failed.

ortho.source: Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024 (OSIP_2024_WM), exportImage JPEG at 0.5 m, georeferenced from the request bbox by make_ortho.py (GitHub release florence-data, exportImage.jpg); lines up with OSM greens and bunkers within about 1 m

world.note: OSM course boundary bbox (1,095 x 1,036 m, way 304892693) + at least 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred (221 m west/east, 122 m south/north)

scorecard_source: Sandpines Golf Links printed scorecard (scorecard.jpg and scorecard-cover.jpg, GitHub release florence-data), read 2026-10-24. Every row adds up to the printed Out/In/Total; handicap = the men's row (a clean 1-18). Men's ratings/slopes: Black 73.8/128, Blue 71.6/125, Rees 70.1/123, White 69.1/122, Jones 67.2/116, Red 65.6/114 (women: Jones 72.6/128, Red 70.9/121). OSM's handicap tags are a different order (neither card row); the card is used.
attribution: Elevation: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1), 2026-10-24: Blue tees; all water red; the OSM boundary is out of bounds and the driving range is out of bounds; trees in fairways removed; open-coast wind 3-14 mph. Theme sandpines is new (developer approved 2026-10-24): bentgrass turf, dune-grass mounds, shore pine and spruce; the native dune-grass areas (fescue_areas = proposed/native.geojson, make_native.py) are drawn tawny and play as rough (developer 2026-10-24, the card's 'non-kept areas are lateral hazards' rule is not modelled). Hole 8 plays from its Black tee, 208 yd vs Blue 174 (developer 2026-10-24).
